question: How is dependency between tactics obtained?

modes.name: Co-occurrence mining
modes.rests_on: two techniques being used by the same actor or tool
modes.why_not: Association is symmetric, so the ordering had to be assumed rather than learned; and because a total order admits no backward edge, no loop could be expressed.

modes.name: Keyword extraction
modes.rests_on: precondition wording in a technique's own description
modes.why_not: A description that names another technique is cross-referencing it, not asserting a dependency on it; direction again came from the assumption.

modes.name: Attack Flow
modes.rests_on: a dependency an analyst drew in one incident

not_attempted.note: ruled out on the literature and never run, named here so the table cannot be read as reporting them.
modes: Process mining over incident event logs

_why: The shipped L1 (v0.5) resolves on this project's 15-tactic axis, which splits
ATT&CK's defense-evasion into stealth and defense-impairment. The superseded
v0.4 profile resolves on stock ATT&CK's 14. Folding the split back is what
makes the caption's shipped figure comparable with the table body instead of
quoting two coverage fractions against two different denominators.
